children: The Hands-Free Comlink is a convenient device often used by beings working under conditions where both hands are needed to perform a task. This

consists of several linked sound-absorbing pads, placed on the face of the user and connected to an earpiece. When the wearer speaks, the sound-absorbing pads transmit the speech; additionally, the Hands-Free Comlink can be adjusted to pick up only the faintest of whispers, allowing the wearer to use it to communicate quietly when stealth is important.

. Hands-Free Comlinks can process audio, but not video or holo.
